MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "Test leads and heat shrink tubing fit the practical work suggested by my breadboards, battery holder, and relay: making temporary connections and insulating finished wiring.",
    "The caliper feels useful for checking component sizes and mounting dimensions, so it supports projects I already work on."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "Printer filament, milling cutters, and a deburring tool assume equipment or fabrication tasks that my purchases do not establish.",
    "Heavy-duty magnets do not solve a current mounting need for me, even though I have bought fasteners and casters.",
    "The LCR meter and extra LEDs fit my interests, but I lack an immediate measurement need and already received LEDs in my PCB kit."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "My interest in electronics projects seems to have been stretched into a broader interest in machining and 3D printing supplies.",
    "Buying components seems to have been taken as a reason to buy more related supplies, without considering whether I already have enough or need specialized equipment."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "I am most ready to choose supplies with a clear use alongside my existing wiring and prototyping parts.",
    "Related items are not always additional needs: I would choose one heat shrink assortment today, and another bulk LED pack would overlap with my previous kit.",
    "A tool can interest me without being something I would choose now; the LCR meter would need a specific testing task."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The recommendations recognized my electronics work but extended that interest too far into fabrication supplies and purchases without an immediate use."
}
